import chrono
import irrlicht
from chrono import ChSystemIrrlicht
from chrono.vehicle import ChVehicle, ChTireModelList, ChTireModelRigid, ChSteering, ChEngine, ChTransmission, ChDriveline, ChWheel, ChHub, ChAssistantSpring, ChTSDAxle, ChTire, ChVehicleIrrlicht

# Initialize the PyChrono environment and core components
chrono.SetChronoDataPath('path/to/chrono/data')
my_system = chrono.ChSystem()

# Add the required physical systems and objects as specified
# Create HMMWV
vehicle = ChVehicle()
my_system.Add(vehicle)

# Location and orientation
location = chrono.ChCoordsysD(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0))
vehicle.SetChassisBody(location)

# Rigid tire model
tire_model = ChTireModelList()
tire_model.AddTireModel(ChTireModelRigid())
vehicle.SetTireModelList(tire_model)

# Visualization
vehicle.AddVisualizationType(ChVehicleIrrlicht.VISUALIZATION_TYPE_MESH)

# Create SCM terrain
terrain = chrono.ChTerrain()
terrain_size = 50
terrain_width = 5
terrain_height = 1
terrain_mat = chrono.ChMaterialSurfaceNSC()
terrain_mat.SetFriction(0.8)
terrain_mat.SetRestitution(0.2)
terrain_mat.SetYoungsModulus(5e7)
terrain_mat.SetPoissonsRatio(0.3)
terrain_mat.SetDensity(1500)
terrain.SetMaterialSurface(terrain_mat)
terrain.SetSize(chrono.ChVectorD(terrain_size, terrain_width, terrain_height))
terrain.SetCellSize(chrono.ChVectorD(1, 1, 1))
terrain.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -0.5, 0))
my_system.Add(terrain)

# Soil parameters
